description: Public starter rubric. Write each question so a yes is unambiguous and checkable against the item text alone. Replace these with your own questions; keep private rubrics out of this repository.

questions.text: Does the reply resolve the customer's stated problem?
questions.guidance: Yes only if the reply takes or confirms the action that fixes the problem.

questions.text: Does the reply state a concrete amount, date or next step?
questions.guidance: Generic policy language or 'we will be in touch' is a no.
